title: Business audit
description: See who changed a project, delivery or access permission, and compare the recorded values.
periodNote: Dates use UTC. Select up to 366 days; exports include up to 5,000 events matching the applied filters.
invalidPeriod: Choose valid dates in order, no more than 366 days apart.
exportError: Could not export the history. Try again.
exportLimit: More than 5,000 events match. Narrow the dates or filters and export again.
error: Could not load the history. Use Refresh to try again.
emptyHint: Try another period or remove a filter. Only recorded changes are included.
coverage: Records begin when audit logging was enabled. Project changes, delivery decisions and access changes are retained without an expiry date. This screen cannot edit or delete them.
scope: You see only currently accessible projects and authorized fields. Deleted projects are excluded. CSV uses the same access rules. Names reflect current memberships.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view business audit history.
